commands_used: answer 1. I woke in the hold of a barge with a gang of strangers, door locked. I seem to be on a work roll but my name is not on it. I do not know who I work for. 2. Speak to Okeeh, the cook, in the barge hold, to find out where I am. 3. Talk to Okeeh; others here are Hara-Jeel and Dralin Uveran; the door is locked. 4. I do not understand the work roll or why no name; I can ask Okeeh.

answer 1. I am in the hold of an Owing barge at Ashgate Landing, a reed-cutters camp in Black Marsh. The gang serves months of work cutting reed instead of a cell. Gang-master Dralin Uveran will take names on his roll. 2. Give my name, then tell Okeeh my trade. 3. Seven trade topics will be offered; the door stays locked until names are taken. 4. I do not fully understand the Owing, Hist, or Jal-Veesa; I can ask Okeeh.

answer 1. I am on an Owing barge at Ashgate Landing; I refused the preset trades and Okeeh asked me to name my five best skills, each gets a bit easier by five. 2. Name five skills to Okeeh, one at a time, in the hold. 3. I can choose any five skills; she will not take the same twice. 4. I still do not know what the Owing, a Hist or Jal-Veesa fully mean; Okeeh has topics on them. I do not yet know which skills are valid names.

answer 1. I named Sneak to Okeeh and it rose by five. Four more to name; at the fifth the hold door bar lifts. 2. Name four more skills to Okeeh. 3. Any other skills from her list. 4. Nothing new that I do not understand beyond the Owing, Hist, Jal-Veesa.
answer 1. Named Sneak and Lockpicking; both rose by five. 2. Name three more skills to Okeeh. 3. Choose from the remaining skills. 4. Nothing new.
answer 1. Named Sneak, Lockpicking, Archery; each up five. 2. Name two more skills to Okeeh. 3. Choose from remaining skills. 4. Nothing new.
answer 1. Four skills named so far: Sneak, Lockpicking, Archery, One-Handed. 2. Name one more skill to Okeeh. 3. Choose from the remaining skills. 4. Nothing new.

answer 1. I named all five skills: Sneak, Lockpicking, Archery, One-Handed, Light Armor. The hold door bar should lift. 2. Look around and leave the hold, then meet the gang-master Dralin Uveran who takes names on his roll. 3. Go out the door, talk to Dralin, Hara-Jeel. 4. Still unsure about the Owing, Hist, Jal-Veesa, and why my name might not be on the roll.

answer 1. I named my five skills and someone unbarred the hold door from outside. 2. Go out onto the landing through the Door to Barge Hold. 3. Use the door; or talk more to Okeeh first. 4. Still do not know the Owing, Hist, Jal-Veesa in detail; Okeeh has topics.

answer 1. My name was struck from the Owing roll this morning on an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. She wants me at her house in Jal-Veesa, east up the road; nobody knows why. 2. Go to Vosh-Leera house in Jal-Veesa; optionally gather Sithis beard moss at Reed-Sill Weir on the way for the tree-minder. 3. Go straight to Jal-Veesa, or fetch the moss first, minding crocodiles. 4. I do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me, who my friends in high places are, or what a Hist is.

answer I am Tarin. I woke on an Owing barge at Ashgate Landing, a reed-cutters camp in Black Marsh, west of Loriasel. I named Sneak, Lockpicking, Archery, One-Handed and Light Armor to Okeeh the cook; each rose by five. Gang-master Dralin Uveran says my name was struck from his roll this morning on an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. She wants me at her house in Jal-Veesa, east up the road; no one knows why. On the way, at Reed-Sill Weir where the road meets the creek, the town tree-minder wants Sithis beard, a grey moss hanging over the creek below the weir; watch for crocodiles. I carry a lockpick. Unknown: why Vosh-Leera wants me, who the friends in high places are, what a Hist is.
